text: Your STRIFE SPECIBUS has been ALLOCATED with the HAMMERKIND ABSTRATUS.
The HAMMER has been moved from your CAPTCHALOGUE DECK to your STRIFE DECK.
alt: You drag the HAMMER into the STRIFE SPECIBUS, giving it a HAMMER icon. A panel appears inside of it, labelled 'SYLLADEX :: STRIFE DECK'. It contains the HAMMER.
